name: Button Collection
description: Twelve button treatments in one component, from a lifting ink button to a key that presses down.

props.name: effect
props.description: The treatment. lift: ink that rises 2px. fill: an outline that fills with water from the bottom. draw: a water line draws itself round the border. frost: glass over a blurred backdrop. ripple: a ring spreads from where it was pressed. sheen: a band of light crosses on hover. underline: a text button with a sliding underline. reveal: an arrow slides in as the label shifts. keycap: a key that presses down. halo: a soft water ring pulses outward. swap: the label rolls up to altLabel. march: a dashed border whose dashes travel.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, with optional 16 pixel icons.

props.name: altLabel
props.description: For swap: the label that rolls in on hover. Defaults to children. It is hidden from assistive technology, so the accessible name stays the first label.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button. The draw and march effects trace the standard 10px corner; if you change the radius, set --miyuki-button-collection-radius to match.
